source: Original supplied training shard 0; reserve first 1024 rows and exclude all copies of their question texts
objective: Original target-token negative log likelihood with existing numeric/operator weight 2. No added labels, teacher, generated targets or changed programs.
architecture: Train a 513-parameter decoder-state gate and 32 attention-head mixture weights. Combine ordinary vocabulary probability with the source-token copy distribution. Strict greedy decoding of the learned mixture.
selection: Positive executed-answer gain on both existing held-out subsets with no additional total execution failures. Confirm a promising result before any larger training; no automatic extension.
limitations: Frozen-feature fitting only. Teacher-forced feature training does not directly optimize whole-program correctness. Reused validation is exploratory; all-head diagnostic is not an accuracy guarantee.
previous_goal_turn: Progress: completed three matched decoder-dropout runs; both regressed, retained best and released compute.
